input-method/native_text_commit.permission_model: portal/compositor mediated; no broad input privilege
input-method/native_text_commit.focus_requirements: target must have text input focus
input-method/native_text_commit.notes: requires compositor text-input support and client integration; not generic injection — must be qualified per lane

accessibility/automation.permission_model: AT-SPI a11y bus; not broad input
accessibility/automation.notes: AT-SPI present but not qualified as reliable delivery for 1.0

virtual-keyboard/keyboard-emulation.permission_model: compositor virtual keyboard (zwp_virtual_keyboard via wtype) or libei/EIS; not uinput by default
virtual-keyboard/keyboard-emulation.unicode: limited — key symbols are layout dependent; emoji/composite glyphs unreliable
virtual-keyboard/keyboard-emulation.notes: wtype present=True (v0.4 daemon proved this mechanism on this host class); libei=False

clipboard+paste.permission_model: Wayland data-control/clipboard; transient ownership, bounded timeout
clipboard+paste.verification_possible: limited — clipboard ownership check, no insertion ack
clipboard+paste.clipboard_impact: overwrites clipboard unless preserved with verified ownership
clipboard+paste.failure_detection: set-ok but paste unverified; timeout to Inbox
clipboard+paste.notes: transactional semantics required: journal before overwrite, restore only while ownership is still ours

Inbox.notes: always-available safe sink; never loses final text

notes: Delivery matrix probe: backend/tool capability truth + Unicode fixtures + per-backend matrix. Backends: wtype=True wl-clipboard=False libei=False atspi=False uinput_present=True in_input_group=True. Unicode fixtures (ascii/accented/emoji/urdu-arabic/cjk/multiline/punctuation/large_5k): all UTF-8 roundtrips pass=True. Router order stays semantic -> virtual-keyboard/clipboard transaction -> Inbox; uinput is opt-in only and never the default onboarding path. Real per-target insertion evidence (native Wayland editor, browser, Electron, terminal, XWayland) is collected during P0F execution with a focused target; this probe records backend/tool truth only.
